_readme: CARD SCANS TCGDEX DOES NOT HAVE, HOTLINKED FROM TCGPLAYER INSTEAD.
Every card picture on this site comes from assets.tcgdex.net, and a handful
of real cards are simply not in it. Three of them are logged hits, so the
Hall of Fame drew them as a grey 'No scan' box with the name in it while a
THIS IS A PIN LIST AND NOT A FALLBACK. Nothing is guessed: each entry names
the TCGplayer product the owner linked, and the id in that url is what the CDN
path is built from. A card is added here only after its TCGdex url has been
checked and found to 404, so an entry can never quietly shadow a scan we
KEYS ARE '<corpus set name>|<collector number>', which is the pair
public/data/printings uses and the pair a rip log row resolves to. Not the
card name: two sets can print the same name and only the pair is unique.
TWO RENDITIONS, BOTH MEASURED 23 Aug 2026. `_200w` is 13-29KB and `_in_
1000x1000` is 135-170KB, both answer 200 with and without a referrer. They
carry NO width or height, because tcgplayer-cdn pads to a fixed canvas and
imgDims() in shared/format.mjs returns nothing for that host on purpose.
To add one: find the card on tcgplayer.com, take the number out of the
/product/<id>/ path, and record why TCGdex has no scan for it.

30th Celebration|050/185.why: TCGdex took 30th Celebration on 18 September 2026 but holds the Classic Collection as a SEPARATE set, `30th-c`, with NO images: every assets.tcgdex.net/en/me/30th-c/... url answers 404, checked before these were added. It also renumbers those reprints 001-030 instead of keeping the original numbering the cards actually print, so even a working image could not be joined to a hit by number. These 30 are the whole subset, so a hit on any of them resolves rather than only the ones already pulled. THE PRODUCT IDS ARE NOT GUESSED, which is this file's standing rule. Each one is read off TCGplayer's own listing for the set "ME: 30th Celebration Classic Collection", filtered to that exact set name, and written into data/30th-checklist.json by scripts/sync-30th-tcgplayer.mjs -- the same ids the binder already draws its Classic Collection pockets from and has since 16 September.

Celebrations Classic Collection|CC001.why: Celebrations Classic Collection CC001, printed 2/102. TCGdex holds no Classic Collection at all: its Celebrations set (cel25) lists the 25 main cards only, and the printings corpus row for this card carries no scan base; checked 2 October 2026 before this was added. The product id is read off TCGplayer's own search filtered to the exact set name "Celebrations: Classic Collection" (25 results, one per card), matched on the printed number 2/102 and the name "Blastoise". The owner asked for these pictures on 2 October 2026.
